name: Kám (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, tan at the hoist and red at the fly, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Kám (a red shield with a yellow star and a bunch of grapes) below the name KÁM in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
